purpose: Fix for the weak-update CIFAR result in ../strong_reward: the 2,627-parameter output adapter barely moved the policy (reward 0.60 -> 0.65 while best-of-4 reaches 0.96, and proxy/gold agree on natural samples 0.957/0.950). Here the whole pretrained UNet is fine-tuned, as in the public Flow-GRPO/DDPO recipes, with the same proxy/gold classifier pair.
sampler: released 50-step leading-schedule fixed_large DDPM (stock-matched; pretrained = zero update)
reward: proxy frog probability averaged over identity and horizontal flip
trainable: full UNet (35.7M); frozen copy as KL reference

evaluation.primary: gold frog accuracy and probability, trained minus pretrained, paired bootstrap 95% CI
secondary: gold-feature Frechet vs 1000 real CIFAR test frogs
controls: best-of-4 from pretrained by proxy reward

rule: final weights evaluated, no early stopping; stop a seed on non-finite loss
